crew.overview: A fatalistic car crash in Mexico city sets off a chain of events in the lives of three people: a supermodel, a young man wanting to run off with his sister-in-law, and a homeless man. Their lives are catapulted into unforeseen situations instigated by the seemingly inconsequential destiny of a dog.
crew.title: Amores Perros

details.biography: Juan Carlos Rulfo (Mexico City, January 24, 1964) is a Mexican filmmaker. Heir to the tradition of his father Juan Rulfo, Juan Carlos has been able to translate into cinematographic narrative the rural Mexican atmospheres that his father enshrined in his literature and at the same time forge a career for himself that has taken him out of his father's shadow to demonstrate his talent.
details.name: Juan Carlos Rulfo
